result.question: What was Tesla's operating income in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer: Tesla's operating income (income from operations) for fiscal year 2025 was $4,355 million, as reported in its 10-K Consolidated Statements of Operations [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p007]. This figure is also corroborated by the XBRL-tagged fact for OperatingIncomeLoss for the period ending December 31, 2025 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss:2025-12-31].
